Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Civil Sectt. Lko.
Counsel for Applicant :- Ambrish Kumar Dwivedi,Akhtar Husain,Ravi Dwivedi
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.

2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.375 of 2022, under Sections 376, 366, 323,
344 IPC, Police Station Tambor, District Sitapur.
3. In terms of the FIR, it was alleged that father of the informant had married her by the use of force and sold her at Rs.50,000/-.

It was also alleged that subsequently the informant was married to the applicant without her consent and thereafter, on various occasions, the applicant as well as two other co-accused had committed wrong on her.
The FIR in question was lodged through an Damodar vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ...

4. The Counsel for the applicant draws my attention to the Marriage Card which indicates that the marriage was solemnized as an arrange marriage with the consent of the family members.
The photographs on record also suggest that the marriage was solemnized in the presence of the villagers.
5. Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the bail prayer.

6. Considering the fact that there is nothing on record to demonstrate that the informant had filed any application for declaring the marriage null and void and the mandate of Explanation 2 of Section 375 of IPC, as the informant was allegedly married to the applicant coupled with the fact that the applicant does not have any criminal antecedents and is in custody since 07.12.2022, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

7. Let the applicant Damodar be released on bail in the abovesaid first information report number on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
